p.title: v59.98 '부도덕', '상향식' and '하향식' no longer count as stance keyword hits
p.symptom: A news title with 부도덕 (immoral), 상향식 or 하향식 (bottom-up, top-down) counted the stance keywords 부도, 상향 or 하향 and could tilt the item's bull/bear stance.
p.root_cause: Korean stance keywords match as substrings; SUBSTRING_EXCLUSIONS listed only 분위기 for 위기.
p.fix: keyword-match.js SUBSTRING_EXCLUSIONS adds 부도 → 부도덕, 상향 → 상향식, 하향 → 하향식 (all three confirmed as stance keywords in scoring.js BULL_KEYWORDS/BEAR_KEYWORDS).
p.violated_rule: A keyword hit is the word itself, not a longer word that contains it.
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check asserts the three false matches are gone while 건설사 부도 우려, 목표가 상향 and 전망 하향 still hit.
p.verification: The new check failed before the fix (three false hits) and passes after; ci-expect-output-check reports no fixture output change.

changelog: **뉴스 성향 단어의 부분 일치 ({P}):** '부도덕', '상향식', '하향식'은 성향 단어 '부도', '상향', '하향'으로 세지 않는다.
